title: workteam review findings
description: What critic, auditor and tester return when a dispatch asks for JSON (claude -p --json-schema, codex exec --output-schema). Markdown is rendered from it by scripts/findings.js. Every property is required so the schema works in strict structured-output mode.

subject.description: Path of the artifact or change package reviewed.

lens.description: The reviewer's lens, letter or name.

contract_item.description: The criterion or clause at stake, or 'none: out of contract'.

where.description: file:line, artifact section, or the evidence gap for an omission.

why_load_bearing.description: What breaks or what the user does not get if it stays.

what_closes_it.description: The concrete action that closes it.

verified.description: What was checked and found sound.
